verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ (٢x)
verses.tr: Ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalā Muḥammad · Ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam (2x)
verses.en: Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad; Allah bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar: رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ مُجْتَمَعْنَا ۞ غَايَتُهُ حُسْنُ الْخِتَامِ
verses.en: My Lord, make the goal of our gathering the best of endings.

verses.ar: وَاعْطِنَا مَا قَدْ سَأَلْنَا ۞ مِنْ عَطَايَاكَ الْجِسَامِ
verses.tr: Wa-ʿṭinā mā qad sa'alnā · min ʿaṭāyāka-l-jisāmi
verses.en: And grant us what we have asked of Your immense gifts.

verses.ar: وَاكْرِمِ الْأَرْوَاحَ مِنَّا ۞ بِلِقَا خَيْرِ الْأَنَامِ
verses.en: Honor our souls with the meeting of the best of created beings.

verses.ar: وَابْلِغِ الْمُخْتَارَ عَنَّا ۞ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَسَلَامِ
verses.tr: Wa-blighi-l-mukhtāra ʿannā · min ṣalātin wa salāmi
verses.en: And convey to the Chosen One, from us, blessings and greetings of peace.

verses.ar: يَا اللّٰهُ يَا مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يَا صِدِّيقْ
verses.tr: Yā Allāhu yā Muḥammad · Yā Abā Bakrin yā Ṣiddīq
verses.en: O Allah, O Muhammad ﷺ; O Abu Bakr, O ever-truthful one.

verses.ar: يَا عُمَرْ عُثْمَانْ يَا عَلِي ۞ فَاطِمَةْ بِنْتَ الرَّسُولِ
verses.tr: Yā ʿUmar ʿUthmān yā ʿAlī · Fāṭimah binta-r-Rasūli
verses.en: O Umar, Uthman, O Ali; O Fatima, daughter of the Messenger.
